title: Potato of Life Creative Artifact History Registry
status: artifact-index and provenance contract; not a doctrine owner
purpose: Track works, prompts, images, games, poems, performances, simulations and other artifacts as historical carriers of Potatoverse ideas. Concept registries answer what a symbol means; this registry answers where an idea appeared, in what medium, in which version, and what later work grew from it.
rule: An artifact can be historically important without being canonical doctrine. Preserve origin, medium, date, exactness, derivatives and relation to canon rather than copying its content into multiple master files.

origin_classes.TIM_PRIMARY: Direct Tim-authored or Tim-produced artifact with recoverable source.
origin_classes.USER_CONVERSATION_PRIMARY: Direct user-created concept or artifact specification surviving in ChatGPT conversation.
origin_classes.AI_ASSISTED: Artifact materially co-developed with an AI system; authorship/provenance should remain explicit.
origin_classes.ASSISTANT_CREATED: Primarily assistant-generated derivative or joke retained as cultural archaeology rather than Tim quotation.
origin_classes.MEMORY_RECOVERY: Remembered artifact whose original source has not yet been recovered.
origin_classes.EXTERNAL_COMPARATIVE: Outside work or text used as a comparator rather than a Potatoverse artifact.

great_book_crosswalk_contract.purpose: Let readers see what an early formulation actually said and what it later became without rewriting the past through the mature canon.

promotion_rule: Create a new artifact record when the work itself matters historically. Do not create a new concept identity merely because an artifact uses a new phrase once. Recurring concepts belong in the canonical concept registry only after recurrence/function justify promotion.
